facts.fact: The federal communications minister commissioned the first NUCAP tower in Bende, Abia State, on 16 October 2026, the start of a rollout of 3,700 sites meant to connect nearly 20 million Nigerians in unserved and underserved communities.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy

NGA.note: Towers serve communities, not local government offices.
